summary: A trim logs one line each time it patches the replication snapshot, with whether it had to copy a snapshot an exchange still held and how long it held the build lock; a trim chunk held over a second also names its longest stages, down to each statement of the delete; and replication exports record profiler spans for sealing, the snapshot, its build-lock wait and build, the difference, envelopes, signatures and body fitting

schema.detail: No table, trigger or index change.

rules.detail: No retention change. The trim deletes what it deleted before, in the same statements and order.

compatibility.detail: No API, wire or config change. The slow-chunk line gains a stages field; its other fields are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert the build as usual; an older build logs neither the patch line nor the stages.
